observations: A wide-brimmed hat with a small clustered ornament of tight green and rust loops at the upper left dominates the upper half; its brim extends toward the right edge, rendered in layered yellow-green and grey strokes.
Large translucent circles in pale grey and soft peach float across the figure, overlapping the hat brim and lower face, blurring the boundary between figure and the pale blue-white background.
Fine dark scribbled lines run across the neck and chest beneath the colour washes; a few yellow-gold lines trace the jaw and collar, adding a harder edge against the otherwise diffuse forms.
reading: The figure tilts downward, face partly hidden beneath the hat's shadow. Overlapping soft circles dissolve the outline so that solid form and open atmosphere trade places across the surface. The scribbled underlayer shows through the washes, giving the image a layered, unresolved quality that reads as quiet rather than incomplete. The small ornament at the hat's crown—tight loops of green and rust—is the one dense, specific detail in an otherwise diffuse field.
